subject: german
title: Music & Reading
welcome_lead: Musik, Buch, Klavier — hobbies at home.
meta_desc: KS3 German: music, reading, indoor hobbies.

walkthroughs.body_html: 'Ich hore Musik' = I listen to music. Horen = to listen. 'Ich hore Rockmusik' = I listen to rock.
'Ich lese ein Buch' = 'I read a book'. Lesen = to read. Pair with the noun.
For instruments use spielen: 'Ich spiele Klavier' (I play piano), 'Ich spiele Gitarre'. No 'a' or 'the' needed.
